summary.title: Feedly Threat Intelligence: Collect, analyze, and share actionable intelligence
summary.one_liner: Feedly Threat Intelligence is a commercial CTI platform that aggregates threat signals from 10,000+ sources, uses AI to extract entities and tag TTPs, and exports STIX-formatted intel.
takeaways: Feedly Threat Intelligence collects signals from 10,000+ clear and dark web sources using Intel Agents.
Its AI models extract entities, identify incidents, and tag TTPs, with a Real-Time Threat Graph linking articles, actors, CVEs, malware families, TTPs and IoCs.
Ask AI provides deep citations back to original sources so analysts stay in control of AI answers.
Integrations deliver STIX-formatted threat intelligence to security stacks and stakeholders.
The vendor describes a 30-day trial: kickoff, Ask AI research and Report Builder briefings, then impact measurement.
summary.summary: This is a vendor marketing page for Feedly Threat Intelligence, a commercial platform for cyber threat intelligence (CTI) teams. It describes three core areas: Intel Agents that continuously collect threat signals from 10,000+ clear and dark web sources, Ask AI for researching threats with citations, and integrations that deliver STIX-formatted intel. It also lists threat graph scale figures (10M+ articles, 979 threat actors, 300K+ CVEs, 681M+ IoCs) and outlines a 30-day trial plan. The page contains little technical detail about implementation, pricing, or architecture, so it is best treated as a product overview rather than a tutorial.
